items.problem: Navigation item labels carry a numeric prefix ('1) Basic Media Casting', '2) ...') vs the bare source scenario titles.
items.evidence: discrepancies.md 'Minor / cosmetic' section; migration-score.json navigation discrepancy type 'label-prefix' severity 'cosmetic'.
items.covered_clearly_at: This is the standard WinUI/UWP SDK-sample numbering convention, not a migration rule; no skill guidance instructs adding a prefix and the scoring judged it cosmetic (all 3 features still PASS).
items.why_no_skill_change: Cosmetic and scenario-specific; it did not affect functionality or score, and only tripped the eval tool's title-driven capture (an evaluation-skill concern, out of scope). A re-run may or may not add the prefix; no migration-skill edit generalizes here.
